## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix how `--json` handles a following option: it currently consumes `--junit` as its destination, breaking combined usage. This review read both changed files in full and checked the tests; no tests or repository code were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds optional JSON destinations and a report-writing function. It also adds tests for JSON destinations and required JUnit paths.

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Preserve following options when JSON uses its default — For `["--json", "--junit", "x.xml"]`, the parser raises `ValueError("unknown option: x.xml")` instead of selecting both report destinations. The JSON branch treats any following token as its path and consumes it, including `--junit`. — Users cannot place pathless `--json` before `--junit`, so valid combined report requests fail. — Fix: Consume the following token only when it is a path; otherwise retain `results.json` and let the loop process the next option.
